lesson.title: Paint marks in space
lesson.description: The source Painter follows the recorded hands, head and feet. Each stroke is an editable three.js line, revealed over time.
lesson.instructions: Use the director camera to explore. Select objects to inspect geometry and materials. Open Script → Edit to change behavior or parameters. Alt/Option+P plays the lesson.
